# Data Analysis in R

Build a practical foundation in R through five hands-on parts: from the first line of code to clear visualizations, reproducible transformations, tidy data, and well-organized projects.

<p class="workshop-lead">Workshop developed and led by <strong>Asst. Prof. Jan Gačnik</strong>.</p>

:::

::: {.student-note}
**Before the workshop:** install R and RStudio, install the required packages, and test the starter project. The [setup guide](setup.qmd) walks through every step.
:::

## What you will learn

::: {.course-grid}
::: {.course-card}
<span class="part-number">01</span>

### Introduction to R

Understand why R is useful, meet RStudio, work with objects and functions, and learn how packages extend R.

[Open Part 1](R_part1.qmd)
:::

::: {.course-card}
<span class="part-number">02</span>

### Data visualization

Build clear, publication-ready graphics layer by layer with `ggplot2`.

[Open Part 2](R_part2.qmd)
:::

::: {.course-card}
<span class="part-number">03</span>

### Data transformation

Filter, mutate, group, and summarize data using a reproducible pipeline.

[Open Part 3](R_part3.qmd)
:::

::: {.course-card}
<span class="part-number">04</span>

### Data tidying

Recognize tidy data, reshape tables, and turn difficult inputs into analysis-ready datasets.

[Open Part 4](R_part4.qmd)
:::

::: {.course-card}
<span class="part-number">05</span>

### Projects and data import

Use relative paths, organize an RStudio project, and import real data reliably.

[Open Part 5](R_part5.qmd)
:::
:::

## How to use these materials

::: {.use-grid}
::: {.use-item}
### Before

Complete the [installation and preparation guide](setup.qmd). If possible, do this a day before the workshop so there is time to resolve installation problems.
:::

::: {.use-item}
### During

Keep the interactive HTML slides open in your browser and use RStudio for the hands-on exercises. Code examples marked as interactive can also run directly in the browser.
:::

::: {.use-item}
### After

Use the PDFs for quick reference and return to the interactive slides whenever you want to rerun an example. The complete source remains available in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jgacnik/Data_analysis_in_R).
:::
:::
